statements.quote: We continue to see that clients turn to IBM for our technology and our expertise in enterprise AI, and our book of business for generative AI has grown to more than two billion dollars since the launch of watsonx one year ago
statements.notes: 'More than two billion dollars' recorded as a floor of $2B. This is a generative AI 'book of business' (bookings plus revenue), not recognized revenue. It is cumulative since the watsonx launch about a year earlier (mid-2023 to mid-2024), so it spans fiscal 2023 and 2024 and is not fiscal 2024 revenue. fiscal_year is null because the sentence names no year; do not read it as fiscal 2024 AI revenue.
